lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of circular high-luminance pixel clusters arranged in a semi-linear pattern across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that cross the horizontal rows to form a grid-like structure, with spots positioned at the approximate center of each grid node.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges on the upper third of the flank exhibit a sharp vertical gradient, with a light-intensity superior edge and a dark-intensity inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density cluster of high-luminance pixels scattered across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.
